text_block_list.text: While preparing after being asked to film a promotional video for the academy with the Umamusume I train...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I never dreamed that Opera O-san
would make an impromptu appearance in the shoot...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha!
I am simply fated to be drawn to the stage!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let my beauty be etched into the digital sea!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fueee~! Opera O-san, you're magnificent as always today!
...You win hands down!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'll make sure to add extra flair to my fave's big moment!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, your spirit and your outfit are both wonderful!
If this were high society, I would be offering you my arm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, thank you so much!!
Ugh, I'm so glad to be alive... I'm so glad I designed this for you Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ho, you seem to have a particular attachment to that outfit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! How to highlight the Umamusume's
cuteness during a race...
I've already come up with over 100 design drafts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What I was most particular about was the base color: white!
I carefully selected a fabric that makes other Umamusume-chan shine the most, and even if I say so myself, it turned out truly satisfying...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, some of the color schemes were crafted to blend in with the diverse colors of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Also, with the concept of 'becoming accessories for Umamusume-chan,'
we scattered decorations all around!
And then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! I'm so sorry!!
I got carried away, I'm so sorrrrryyy!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "...Brava!! To think so deeplyand broadly about a single outfit!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To perform upon the turf while simultaneously
overseeing the stage as its director!
You are a true all-rounder!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyoe... !?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, beyond that dedication lies the desire
to make the race the absolute best it can be,
both for their opponent and for themselves."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today was the shoot for the school recruitment video, right?
I'd like to leave... the composition to Digital-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!? Me, taking on such a huge role!?
Wh-What should I do, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: Let's make it the greatest masterpiece you can imagine!
Let's make it the best masterpiece you can imagine!
How about the two of you think about it together?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!? Me, taking on such a huge role!?
Wh-What should I do, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: Let's make it the greatest masterpiece you can imagine!
Let's make it the best masterpiece you can imagine!
How about the two of you think about it together?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san banishes the darkness from the world
just by existing... She's such a magnificent Umamusume!
Keeping her all to yourself should practically be a crime!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The way she shines upon the wide world is truly like the sun!
I want to push that right to the forefront!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The sun... Ah, what a magnificent ring it has.
Please, lead the way... to your masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... I'm so happy
I feel like I'm gonna explode...!!
I'll stake everything on this outfit and make... the absolute best video ever!
And so, under Agnes Digital's direction, video shooting was underway...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...That's a wrap for the shoot!
Opera O-san, you really were the champion after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is editing the footage on the PC.
...Um, would it be alright if I took care of that...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Silence is golden at times. The Overlord shall sit back and look forward to the completed beauty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~n. Even their departure is sho gorgeous...
I'll stan forever, I'll definitely stan them for life~~.

Just what kind of video will this turn out to be?
With high expectations, we decided to call it a day.

"Even if you cannot see the path forward,
even if you lose sight of the guidepost to tomorrow..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...You'll find it, I'm sure.
Your very own 'sun'...!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us aim for glory together!
Bwahahaha!!
"A place where dreams become reality— Soar toward your dreams, Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With the concept of "a smile that illuminates all" for Opera O-san...
how does that sound?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Beautiful... there is no other word for it.
Won't you become the exclusive promoter for my stage?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nfuh!? Th-That's...! Digitan's gonna exploooode~~~!!

Afterward, inquiries regarding admissions increased,
and the PR turned out to be a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyo! Good joooob, Trainer!
I've been dying to see Opera O's performance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll write the script, and Digital will do the editing.
Let's make it a dual-lead blockbuster!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what... I'm gonna appear
in Opera O-san's story?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is strictly for the photoshoot...!
I'm not abusing my authority here, okay?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The photoshoot begins! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ohh, so this is Tracen Academy...!
From this moment, I take my first step as the Supreme Ruler!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And right on cue, Digital-kun steps in
to play the role of the senior Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ohohoho! I wonder if a fledgling like you
can survive...!?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Splendid! It is the dawn of a grand epic!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I met you...
Your presence is what made me the Overlord!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Heh... Next time, I won't lose.
Our battle has only just begun...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And that brings down the curtain!
Good work, you two.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Phaaah! Haaah!!
I'm so sorry! You were just way too close...!
I didn't touch you or anything, did I?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Touch... That's it! I forgot the scene
where I catch you in my arms as you fall!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hohiee~~!?
If this keeps up, I'm gonna break past my limits!!

Putting her life on the line,
Agnes Digital finished all the photo shoots...!
